Definition: from a compound of G3844 and G236; transmutation (of phase or orbit), i.e. (figuratively) fickleness:--variableness.
BiblicalUsage: Parallagē occurs once: every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe no variableness is the comfort of the whole verse: every good gift comes down from a Father who never changes, never shifts, never turns.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
